_meta.source: Combat/enemy.py EnemyDatabase + attack_profile_generator (deterministic profiles) + REAL generate_loot on seeded global random

beetle_armored.name: Armored Beetle
beetle_armored.narrative: Heavily armored beetle with metallic shell. Territorial and aggressive when its area is invaded.

beetle_brown.name: Brown Beetle
beetle_brown.narrative: Common brown beetle with hard carapace. Docile unless threatened, then surprisingly fierce.

beetle_titan.name: Titan Beetle
beetle_titan.narrative: Massive beetle with diamond-hard shell. Ancient guardian that has survived eons.

entity_primordial.name: Primordial Entity
entity_primordial.narrative: Reality-warped entity from beyond comprehension. Existence itself bends around it. Only the most prepared dare engage.

golem_crystal.name: Crystal Golem
golem_crystal.narrative: Crystalline golem pulsing with magical energy. Rare guardian of legendary deposits.

golem_stone.name: Stone Golem
golem_stone.narrative: Animated stone construct that guards ancient places. Slow but nearly indestructible.

inferno_drake.name: Inferno Drake
inferno_drake.narrative: A drake infused with elemental flame. It bathes foes in fire breath, knocks them back with wing beats, and calls down meteors when desperate.

slime_acid.name: Acid Slime
slime_acid.narrative: Corrosive slime that dissolves anything it touches. Highly aggressive and surprisingly fast.

slime_crystal.name: Crystal Slime
slime_crystal.narrative: Crystalline slime formed from pure elemental energy. Extremely rare and dangerously powerful.

slime_green.name: Green Slime
slime_green.narrative: Small green slime that oozes slowly across terrain. Mostly harmless unless you step on it.

storm_titan.name: Storm Titan
storm_titan.narrative: A living storm given form. Lightning arcs from its body, chaining between victims as it slams the ground with thunderous force.

void_archon.name: Void Archon
void_archon.narrative: An archon corrupted by the void. It bends space and shadow to pull victims close before tearing them apart with beams of pure darkness.

void_wraith.name: Void Wraith
void_wraith.narrative: Spectral entity that phases between dimensions. Attacks pass through it unpredictably.

wolf_dire.name: Dire Wolf
wolf_dire.narrative: Larger, more aggressive wolf. Alpha predator that hunts in coordinated packs.

wolf_elder.name: Elder Wolf
wolf_elder.narrative: Ancient wolf wreathed in shadow. Pack leader that has survived countless battles.

wolf_grey.name: Grey Wolf
wolf_grey.narrative: Common grey wolf that roams grasslands and forests. More curious than aggressive, but will defend territory if threatened.
